description: Tool to execute SOQL queries including soft-deleted and archived records. Use when you need to query records that have been deleted via merge or delete operations, or when accessing archived Task and Event records.

query.description: The SOQL query to execute. Unlike standard queries, QueryAll includes soft-deleted records (from merge or delete operations) and archived Task/Event records. Example: 'SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE IsDeleted = true'. Use standard SOQL syntax.
examples: SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE IsDeleted = true
SELECT Id, Name, Email FROM Contact
SELECT Id, Subject, Status FROM Task WHERE IsArchived = true
SELECT Id, Name, Amount FROM Opportunity ORDER BY Amount DESC LIMIT 10
query.human_parameter_description: The SOQL query to execute. QueryAll returns deleted records and archived Task/Event records that standard queries exclude.
query.title: Query

name: query_all

QueryAllRecord.description: A single record returned by the QueryAll query.
QueryAllRecord.title: QueryAllRecord

done.description: Indicates if all query results have been retrieved. False means more records are available via nextRecordsUrl.
done.title: Done

nextRecordsUrl.description: Query locator URL for retrieving the next batch of results. Present only when done is false. Use this URL to get remaining deleted records.
nextRecordsUrl.title: Next Records Url

records.description: Array of records returned by the query. Maximum 2000 records per response. Includes soft-deleted and archived records.
records.title: Records

totalSize.description: Total number of records that match the SOQL query, including deleted and archived records.
totalSize.title: Total Size

RecordAttributes.description: Metadata about the record, including type and URL.

url.description: The REST API URL path to access this specific record.
url.title: Url

RecordAttributes.title: RecordAttributes
